data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Philippos, which translates to 'friend of horses'. In the New Testament, Philip is one of the twelve apostles, and the name is believed to have been given due to his hospitality to horses. The name Phillipp carries the meaning “Friend of horses” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Phillipp usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of horses and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Phillipp total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
data.cultural_impact: The name Phillip has been popular throughout history and has been borne by several prominent figures across various cultures. In Europe, it was commonly used during the Middle Ages and was popularized by the French royal family. In the United States, it gained popularity during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. Today, it is a common name in many English-speaking countries.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, Saint Philip is believed to have been a son of Bethsaida, who was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus. He is known for his willingness to listen and learn from Jesus, and his boldness in preaching the Gospel. The name Phillip signifies devotion, bravery, and a deep willingness to follow the teachings of Jesus and spread the Word of God. It serves as a reminder to be a faithful friend to God and to be open to the guidance and blessings that come from embracing the divine.
